_purpose: One issue of the journal. scripts/build-journal.js reads this file and the articles it names (journal/<id>/<slug>.md; each article's front matter carries its title, dek, author, status and audio) and writes the web edition (site/journal.html), the resolved issue (site/issues/<id>.json) for the viewer's article mode, and the article files.
